method.basis: Exact Founder-supplied 38-page AQA A-level Psychology specification: Section 4, printed pages 17–24, manually verified bullet boundaries and page transitions; no official protected prose copied.
method.observation: 117 original Section 4 content bullets across 17 topic headings. Existing production prototype splits the first Approaches bullet into distinct behaviourist and social-learning pages, yielding 118 published prototype records.
method.mapping: Source section + within-section content bullet ordinal → named existing prototype requirement ID(s) → deterministic Learn page ID in three current course packs.
method.limits: This is a complete top-level Section 4 content-bullet locator inventory only, not a decomposition of all named studies/models/skills or the complete 7182 exam-scope universe. The crosswalk does NOT inspect teaching sufficiency or individual question/rubric quality. General Section 4 Paper 1/2/3 AO/practical requirements, 7.2 maths Annex and Section 5 scheme-of-assessment are separate mandatory audit strands.
method.caution: No 100% coverage claim. Source text is excluded because AQA PDF classified REFERENCE_ONLY. A topic-scoped MCQ is never evidence of individually demonstrated bullet or sub-skill.
